text: Good evening. I'm looking after my granddaughter tonight, she's 8 months old, and I've been up with her since about 9 so forgive me if this rambles a bit. Her temperature is 37.8, I've taken it twice to be sure. One of her eyes has gone pink and sticky, gunky in the corner, and I've been wiping it with cooled boiled water like I used to with my own but it keeps coming back. She's also got a little cough, nothing much, just the odd one now and then. I checked her all over for a rash because my daughter always says to, and there's nothing at all, her skin is clear. It only started yesterday. I'm just not sure if the eye needs something tonight or if it can wait until her mum can take her to the doctor. I've done this before with four of my own but I'm so tired I don't trust myself, if that makes sense.
